notes.title: Patch Notes 1.004 - Nov 28
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v 1.004 Nov - 28

**Important Update:  The Free week has been confirmed, and locked with Valve to start Dec 14th & they have been kind enough to give us some placement support on the front page our first day. Thanks everyone for keeping in tune, we're stoked this is finally locked in.

-----

We’ve been doing a lot of preparation for the Free Week, which launches Dec 14! Free week will be an exciting opportunity to have new players try the game, and to build exposure and the player base.  Alongside with the free week, we’ll be promoting a major discount, and also rolling out  our concurrent user challenge!  In this challenge we will have rewards and in game content for players, based on hitting milestones goals of concurrent users. 

1.004 notes

User Interface

-Base functionality added for Mouse navigation for all Menus (some additional polish is being still being added). We want to submit early to collect info prior to the free week

Added Graphic options for performance control.  Tiled Lighting (dx11 lighting) / SSAO/ Shadows. Players can individually toggle each element, to finetune performance on lower grade pcs.

Crashes

Fixed for a threading issue, causing the game to randomly crash, particularly in Practice mode, FFA, and Posse
Fixed threading issue causing game to randomly crash in menus

Gameplay

Gordo - Gordo had a 2nd pass of fine tuning after collecting data and analytics.

-	Gordos Gatling Acceleration adjusted,now ramping up significantly quicker

-	Gordo Molotov impact was initially delayed .5 seconds to accommodate for latency. After further testing the delay was brought to .2 seconds, to still allow players to react to it, without giving people the ability to evade through fire without taking dmg

- 	Fire does more dmg over time

Kidred

fix for kidred losing his aiming reticule while reloading

Killer

-	Adjustments for killers knife, to reduce the overly broad hit detection  when there is high latency

notes.title: Secret Ponchos Patch 1.03 Live!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes PC 1.03  - Nov 05 2015[/b]


[h1]Character Updates[/h1] 
[b]Gordo[/b]
A series of adjustments (both nerfs and buffs) to make the character more responsive to skilled play, and less overwhelming from unskilled play. Gattlign and slam now have layers where you can perform well, or poorly with them.

-Dead zone fixed :  could not return fire for 18 frames, after being hit
-Gordo now required to accelerate crank on his gattling, instead of starting at full fire rate he now starts firing slow and build over time. A skilled gordo needs to “earn” firing at his opponent at max rate
-Max fire rate decreased 
-Slight increase on dmg per bullet
-Gordos rage (slam) cooldown increased from 5secs to  6secs Gordo can now recover from his own slam animation in 50 frames instead of 84 frames allowing him more escape options in 3v3
-Molotov fire does not deal dmg for the first tick, to compensate for latency and make sure players dont receive dmg before the flames go off
-Molotov now deals dmg every .5 sec instead of every 1.0 secs, to compensate for the first tick not dealing dmg
-Flames Dmg volumes shrunk to better align with Fire FX.  (was extending past the fire fx before)


[b]Gunman[/b] 
Was victim to over effective stunning

-Gunman Stun time fixed,  (reduced 30 frames) to be consistent with other outlaws
-Gunman Knife impact fixed (reduced) to be consistent with other outlaws
-Gunmans Badge no longer equips a mysterious knife


[b]Deserter[/b]
General push to decrease deserters ability to abuse high mobility techniques over and over.  A fix to deserters snipe move, now properly causing stuns.

- Adrenaline cooldown increased to 20 sec. from 15 sec
- Adrenaline duration decreased to 6 sec from 7 sec
- Snipe not stunning bug fix. Players would slide around while falling down. Deserters snipe shot now stuns players
-Snipe move minimum distance now starts at 3 meters, instead of 7 meters. He was getting the ability to instantly stun someone at 7 meters, he now needs to charge
- Increased charge time on Impale slightly to prevent Impale Locks.
-Stamina recovery decreased, to reduce his mobility. Deserter still has 3 stamina units, but using them has a higher cost
- Collision system fixes to make sure deserter cannot shoot people into world Geo with Bayonet


[b]Wolf[/b]
Wolf arrows are now more reliable, but adjusted to be less spammable.

- Wolfs arrows are now more precise & cleaner to hit. Arrow velocity increased, to decrease from the time they are launched to when they hit their target (making things more accurate)
- Wolfs consecutive hit Crit Dmg Bonus increased by 5 units
- Wolf basic arrow fire rate slowed down, to reduce toe to toe combat & Crit spamming and keep crits skill based. This compensates for the cleaner accuracy	


[b]War Monger[/b]
Cleaner throwing

-Tomahawk velocity increased, to make his throws more accurate


[b]Mad Trapper[/b]
More responsive throwing

-	Trappers throw time more responsive. Trap will leave hand 12 frames sooner


[b]Kidred[/b]
More responsive throwing

- Dynamite now leaves his hands much faster on release
- Throwing trajectory has been corrected, so he can properly clear low objects in front of him. Before he would randomly clip objects in front of him making his dynamite unreliable when standing behind objects



[h1]General Features and Fixes[/h1]  

- 	Movesheets now available to view in Pregame, Lobby, and Character creation
-	Gameplay coutndown now starts immediately. There was a deadzone of 3 seconds you had to wait before countdown which has been streamlined out
-	Posse leader now receives 10% dmg (instead of 5%) for each kill in posse mode, to add incentive for combat instead of running
-	Posse leader REMOVED from random search in 3v3. People can still vote for it specifically, but feedback was that random was better suited between deathmatch/domination
- 	fix for crow thumbnail showing in find friends dialogue instead of phantom
-	fix for bounty penalty for leaving Arcade Mode
-	Aesthetic fixes for colors in “elite” seasonal leaderboard
-	misc fixes for some scenarios causing “stuck on launch” at matchmaking screen
-	Added Option to "Start Match with AI" to Rookie Mode and Private Mode

notes.title: Patch Notes - Oct 23 2015 pc 1.002 - Even Playing Field
notes.notes:
[img]http://secret-ponchos.s3.amazonaws.com/Images/Patch1-002.jpg[/img]

Hey everybody!  We are happy to drop in our 2nd patch since launch. This one is more major, and addreses a few larger scale items from community feedback. Thanks to the community, and Id also like to thank and my teammates for working hard to get these changes implimented so quickly.

Stay tuned for the next patch!


-	Stats : All characters will start with 12 perk points, they can assign as they wish

-	Players will no longer earn perk points as they level up

-	Players will not lose bounty any more. If they ended a match with a negative score, their earnings will be zero and not negative

-       Match Reshuffle - If teams are unbalanced, the game will redistribute players to reduce any skill differences where applicable. Premade teams stay together.

-	Grit alternative Skins can now be unlocked via Barter Coins! 

-	Gordo -  Fixed bug where Gordo could start running randomly at his max speed, (instead of his Min speed), at the start of acceleration. This was making him incredibly fast

-	added a tunable cooldown timer for Gordos Ground Slam. Initially set to 4 seconds to match Blind cooldown, and Phantom Whips trike cooldown.

-       Deserter can no longer charge his Cold stare (Snipe) while invisible in cover. Charging it will release him from cover

-	bug fix for deserters heal not being interruptible if player holds down heal button


-	reduced duration of “Boots” powerup

-	reduced the initial default volume of music (won’t affect current installs)

-	Moved spawnpoint on mines level so you don’t run into cart

-	fix for a bug where wolf being able to CRIT hit if she rolls AFTER firing

-	fix for Wolf girl turbo fire exploit caused by weapon switching


-	Fixes for Crashes entering “Rank mode” with steam names with unusual characters

-	fix for “Nice Bounty “ rewards not activating achievements when causing a character to level up


-	Support added to Ban players/cheaters

-	Matador “Blind” no longer will use stamina. instead it is set to a 4 second cooldown. This will keep blind a “skilled strike” (not spammable) while freeing up stamina for Matadors Pounce, evades, and sword slashes. It also means her Blind/Evade combo will only cost 1 stamina isntead of 2, making it more viable

-	Mines level art optimization to increase FPS

-	Fort level art optimization to increase FPS

notes.title: Secret Ponchos is getting a bunch of new stuff for its PC release
notes.notes:
I still have a hard time thinking of Secret Ponchos as a fighting game, even though it was invited to appear at the largest fighting game tournament in the world, EVO. But that s exactly how creative director Yousuf Mapara pitched it when he stopped by to walk me through everything arriving with the final release on September 29. Secret Ponchos has been receiving incremental updates in Early Access since June, but expect new maps, new characters, a new mode, and more with the final release. 

But my biggest takeaway from playing a few matches with the developers wasn t the new content checklist, it was that Secret Ponchos is completely unlike the game I thought it was. Heroes of the Storm simplified MOBAs, stripping away the item shops and some oblique mechanics, but kept the three-lane format. Secret Ponchos does away with everything but the character conflict, and is better for it.

The last I heard or saw of Secret Ponchos was when I played its PlayStation 4 debut, which I didn't have a great time with. There was no tutorial built into the game (now there is), so the character nuance and team strategy was obscured by its familiar presentation as a top-down Spaghetti Western arcade shooter. 

Character study

Yes, it was a bit strange to see Secret Ponchos transition from its PS4 release to Early Access on Steam, but Mapara made it clear they intended to use what they learned from a shaky console release in order to make the PC version something much more substantial. Based on my time with the early release preview, it feels like they're on track. 

Everything clicked when I played as one of the new characters, The Wolf. Her primary weapon is a bow, so she fires slow, but if you score two successive hits, the second will be a critical. If you shoot directly after performing a dodge roll and hit your opponent, it s also a crit. And her alternate ability is akin to the Hunter from Left 4 Dead; she can crouch and pounce on an opponent from a distance, and then slash with her knife. Using her, I fell into a comfortable playstyle. I avoided direct one-on-one encounters, but played on the edge of our skirmishes, rolling into to score a crit here and there, then disappearing as soon as possible—going into cover with any character makes you invisible. When an enemy strayed too far from their team, I d use cover to stalk them before pouncing to ideally take them out.

I also played as The Mad Trapper, who lays traps that can be hidden if you invest an extra few, vulnerable seconds to bury them. I liked his gun a lot, which has a satisfying charge ability, putting me in position to lure enemy players into the open for easier takedowns. The longer I held down the fire button, the further I could shoot, almost like casting a fishing line.

There will be nine outlaws in the final release with room for more, all with noticeably different playstyles. Yousuf told me their design strategy started with art and character or concept before mechanical feasibility. What resulted is a strange mix of personality and gameplay, just don t confuse Secret Ponchos character action and isometric perspective with any MOBA. Certainly, there are shades of influence there, but with no extrinsic objectives, creeps, item shops, and so on, the maps and goals exist entirely to force character on character conflict. Rounds are short and tense. My palms were sweaty after ten minutes, and it didn t take long for Yousuf to take stock of all the curse words I know. It s this intense you-versus-me, no-frills focus that Yousuf argues is exactly why he s making a fighting game.

And I think I get it now.

There's a full press breakdown of the new stuff coming in Secret Ponchos' final release here, but below is a condensed list of what s new.


New Features

  • New matchmaking system
  • AI bots
  • A new progression system
  • A tutorial
  • Five new characters, three of which are PC exclusive
  • Four new maps, two which haven t been in Early Access
  • Protect the Posse Leader, a new game mode

MAIN MENU

GAMEPLAY

notes.title: June 27 Update: Balancing + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]http://secret-ponchos.s3.amazonaws.com/Images/Week4_Final_590.jpg[/img]


The following are Early access bug fixes and balancing adjustments we are currently testing. The balancing adjustments are experimental and not permanent.

MATADOR
Matador sloppiness around her blind has been tightened up, so her visuals are accurately reflecting what the gameplay windows are. Her Banderilla throwing has had several adjustments to make it a more effective option. TDM is punishable now if you make someone miss. Here is a complete list:
Matador Blind was working outside of its range and Visual FX. Hit box should line up with visual range
- Matador Bind move was triggering after the move was complete. Hitbox now active only when the animation is showing the spin.
- Reduced blind time from 8 to 6 (experimental)
- Matador spears regenerate quicker after a miss. Cool-down reduced from 7.0 to 5.0, giving her more potential spear throws per round.
- TDM miss penalty extended from 1 s to 2s. If she misses she's now punishable during recover
- Banderilla crit hit DMG increased from 45 to 50
- Crit opportunity after spear throw has been lengthened (time the first spear stays in opponent)
- Basic spear throw DMG increased from 20 to 25

PHANTOM PONCHO
- Whip hit box increased from 0.3 to 0.4  (for both whip strike, and choke)
- Shotgun width reduced from 10 to 6.6
- Range adjusted 1 meter 7.0 to 6.0
- Shotgun hit box reduced from 1 to 0.1m outside of character (requiring greater accuracy)
- Knockdown time has been reduced to 120 frames, to match other characters


DESERTER
- Deserter shotgun cone width reduced 10 to 7.5
- Deserter shotgun range reduced 7.0 to 6.0
- Deserter shotgun hit box reduced .5 to .2
- Adrenaline cool-down decrease from 20 to 15s
- Adrenaline duration decrease from 11s to 7
- Snipe fire-rate timing adjusted to .75 from 1.0 to eliminate stun-locking

KID RED
- Kid Red’s dual shot now consumes 1 stamina unit. This was considered a better alternative than proposed cool-downs, as you can still dive in and stun 2 enemies quickly (but with a cost).

notes.title: HUGE “12 Weeks ‘Til Showdown" Update Released - Featuring New Outlaw: GORDO!
notes.notes:
[img]http://secret-ponchos.s3.amazonaws.com/Images/12Week_600.jpg[/img]

[h1]UPDATE WEEK 1 (OF 12)[/h1]

Behind the scenes the last few months, we've been working closely with a tiny Early Access community, taking apart Secret Ponchos and rebuilding the matchmaking, new user experience, and expanding the game with brand new content to support the gameplay we love. Now its time to get everyone into the game and expand our Early Access program!


UPDATES:
[list]
[*]3v3 gameplay added - it’s the sweet spot and a real game changer

[*]Added new playable Outlaw "Gordo" - armed with a giant Gatling gun, and deadly Molotov infernos

[*]Smarter matchmaking & searching (created a lobby merging system to bring together players waiting in parallel lobbies)

[*]Mode Vote - redesigned to allow us to have as many modes as we want, without fragmenting player population

[*]Improved Practice Mode - now with an AI bot option 

[*]User experience improvements: leaderboards, in-game chat, custom keybinding, adding Steam friends within game and more
[/list]

More details [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/265750/discussions/0/618463446166424838/]here[/url].

notes.title: Summary of Patch Notes for April 11 - May 24
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Since our announced Early Access return/refocus  at the beginning of April we've been busy with weekly updates (every Saturday morning). We've discussed many of the updates here and there or one-on-one with many of you, but decided it was about time we posted a list of all the major updates, features, etc. in one spot.  Below is a summary of the fixes, features and enhancements we've added to Secret Ponchos over the last 6 weeks. 

• New maps: The Mines and Plaza

• Seasonal Leaderboards Added

• Online Chat Added to lobbies and in-game

• Matchmaking Improvements
      - lobby “merging" to prevent duplicate hung lobbies and get games started
      - added stability to friend chaining
      - experimental rematch feature (still in progress)*

• Game Mode Optimization 
      - compression of 2v2 and 4v4 modes to new 3v3 mode
      - addition of new Mode Vote / Map Vote features to Pre-Game lobby
      - continued streamlining and improvements to game mode options (Solo / Multiplayer, etc) 
      - addition of "Random” Mode Vote and Map Vote options

• Lobby populates before mode chosen to reduce number of unfilled lobbies

• Add friends from Pre-Game (simply select the player to add them - UI on-screen instructions still needed)

• Switching character within Practice Mode (activate via in-game menu)

• Key-binding for Mouse Keyboard added

As many of you may have heard, we have a lot of exciting news coming over the next week, including the date of the official launch of Season Zero sometime in the next 5-10 days. 

Weekly updates will continue and we're super excited to show you guys what we've been working on. More information about Season Zero, an upcoming appearance by a certain Outlaw, and what else we have planned, is just around the corner. 

Thanks!
